description: This file defines the SaveQualificationEducationController class within the OrangeHRM admin plugin. It extends an abstract Vue controller and manages component rendering for editing or saving qualification education data based on request attributes.

classes.name: SaveQualificationEducationController
classes.description: Controller handling qualification education save/edit operations, determines which Vue component to render based on request data.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering. Checks if an 'id' exists in the request attributes to decide whether to load an existing qualification education for editing or prepare for creating new.
